title: Non-atomic write in upsert/upsert_discovered_contact loses contact changes
description: ContactStore::upsert and upsert_discovered_contact execute INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE outside any transaction, commit it, then open a second transaction to advance the state counter and write changed_at_counter. A crash between the two leaves the contact row updated but changed_at_counter stale. Same structural defect as set_blocked and update_last_message_at. Fix: wrap both the initial upsert and the counter/changed_at_counter write in a single transaction.
